The numbers behind the ride.

These stats come from your extracted Mario Kart World data, rather than estimated ratings. Food is excluded.

How each stat is calculated

Driver class points + vehicle class points, clamped to 0–25. The resulting level selects the stat’s multiplier from the game’s level curve. Empty ratio cells resolve to ×1.000.

A higher level means a higher table value, but weight and handling are preferences, not a universal measure of a better combo. A speed multiplier is scaling, not a speed in km/h.

Recommendations

Recommendations rank base character and vehicle pairs by your chosen priority. All-rounder is an equal-weight average of road speed, acceleration, road handling and mini-turbo levels. Ties use the other core levels, then names. Outfits remain selectable in the builder.

Evidence

Formula: main module 0x515300. Curve lookup and terrain selection: 0x65b660. Empty ratio default: 0x3e01f0 and 0x1fc0b50. Standard Kart and Plushbuggy default to V01: 0xab2dc0.

Source: general_format.Product_180.sarc.zs, with English names from EUen game messages. Player combinations only; CPU racers use separate curves.

Artwork is extracted from the game’s UI. The Standard Kart studio image was rendered with Blender MCP using the exported model and color textures. It depicts the vehicle alone.
